name: @w6w-apps/baremetrics
description: Read SaaS subscription metrics and manage API-sourced customers, plans, subscriptions and charges in Baremetrics.

w6w.longDescription:
Baremetrics turns subscription billing data into the metrics a SaaS business steers by: MRR, ARR, churn, LTV, trials and more. This app reads those metrics over any date range, broken out by plan or down to the customers behind a number, and lists the customers, plans, subscriptions, charges and refunds in each connected source.

For teams that bill outside Stripe, Recurly or Braintree, it can also write to the Baremetrics API source: create, update and delete customers, plans, subscriptions and charges. Data that comes from a payment-provider source is read-only, as Baremetrics itself enforces.

Health checks verify the API key and track the hourly request allowance from Baremetrics' own rate-limit headers.
